metadata.title: The Gagliardo-Nirenberg equation on Riemannian manifolds
metadata.abstract: We establish geometric and analytic rigidity results for the Gagliardo-Nirenberg equation. On a complete noncompact Riemannian manifold with nonnegative Ricci curvature, the existence of a positive critical point of the Gagliardo-Nirenberg quotient forces the manifold to be Euclidean and the solution to be extremal. No minimizing assumption or volume growth hypothesis is required, thereby strengthening earlier rigidity results. In Euclidean space, we prove that all positive solutions of the normalized equation whose nonlinear mass on expanding annuli has sublinear growth are extremals. The linear threshold is optimal, as shown by explicit profiles that are constant in one direction. We also prove a sharp pointwise estimate involving the solution and its gradient, valid without assumptions at infinity, with equality at one point characterizing the extremals. The proofs use weighted divergence identities and a reflection argument controlled by annular mass. Explicit constructions reveal the geometric and variational limits of rigidity: nonflat quotient critical points exist beyond the curvature hypothesis, while the normalized equation admits positive solutions even under strictly positive sectional curvature and maximal volume growth.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 在完备非紧且 Ricci 非负的流形上，证明正的 Gagliardo–Nirenberg 商临界点迫使底空间欧氏、解为极值函数，无需极小化或体积增长假设；另给出环带质量阈值与点态锐估计。
analysis.breakthrough: 把极值刚性推进到一般临界点，并展示线性增长阈值的最优性。
analysis.limitations: 商的临界点与正规化方程的一般正解不能混淆，文中正曲率例子说明后者仍可能存在。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
